colorway_justification: User-forced. Navy Boat Tote (cream canvas body, navy leather handles + vertical front straps, gold turn-lock, gold hardware) replaces the burgundy patent original while reading luxe against the beige sofa and green plants. Two 8-second Seedance clips cover the full 16s as one continuous POV.

scenes.image_prompt: POV close-up of a woman's hand holding up a Velantra Boat Tote in the Navy colorway by its rolled navy pebbled-leather top handles. Cream/off-white natural canvas body, two vertical navy pebbled-leather belt straps running down the front and meeting at a centered gold turn-lock clasp, navy leather edge piping, gold hardware throughout, Birkin-inspired structured silhouette. Slightly low angle, shallow depth of field, soft warm indoor lighting with gentle highlights on the gold clasp and natural canvas weave. Background is a softly blurred modern interior with a beige leather sofa on the left and lush green palm leaves on the right, large window. Model wears black long-sleeve top, long manicured nails. Burned into the middle of the frame in 3 lines of bold white sans-serif TikTok-style typography with a soft black drop shadow: "pov: you skip starbies once to buy this handbag that you need✨☁️". Realistic, cinematic, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio.

scenes.motion_prompt: Continuous POV handheld. Hand holds the Velantra Boat Tote up by the handles for a beat showing off the cream canvas and navy leather, then gently lowers the bag down onto the beige leather sofa cushion, settling softly. Subtle handheld sway, micro parallax of palm leaves and sofa in the blurred background, warm indoor light, no zoom.

Hands gently arrange items inside the open Velantra Boat Tote: placing a phone, then the black wallet, then the lipstick into the structured interior, then both hands fold the navy front flap down and rotate the gold turn-lock bar into the locked horizontal position with a satisfying micro-rotation.
